lines: 【信号】纳指（原始打分68%）、标普（原始打分60%）｜模型无样本外区分度：未来20日上涨概率≈基率 62% · 实验性信号
【风险】VIX期限结构正常（23.8 < 23.8），无恐慌；纳指20日年化波动 44%（高波动）
【事件】12-04 非农就业(11月)；12-10 CPI发布(11月) —— 当日波动放大，避免重仓操作
lines_en: [Signal] NASDAQ (raw score 68%), S&P 500 (raw score 60%) | the model shows no out-of-sample discrimination: the 20-day probability of a gain is ~the base rate of 62% · experimental signal
[Risk] VIX term structure normal (23.8 < 23.8), no panic; NASDAQ 20-day annualised volatility 44% (high volatility)
[Events] 12-04 Nonfarm payrolls (for month 11); 12-10 CPI release (for month 11) — volatility is amplified on the day; avoid large positions

lights.name: 趋势(MA200)
lights.note: 牛熊分界线，下方时一切看空信号加倍认真
lights.note_en: The bull/bear dividing line; below it, take every bearish signal twice as seriously.

lights.name: VIX期限结构
lights.note: 倒挂=恐慌（历史上倒挂后20日胜率64.8%，常近底部）
lights.note_en: Inversion = fear (historically the 20-day win rate after an inversion has been 64.8%, often close to a bottom).

lights.name: 收益率曲线(10Y-2Y)
lights.note: 倒挂(<0)是历史上最可靠的衰退预警，领先6-18个月
lights.note_en: An inversion (<0) is historically the most reliable recession warning, leading by 6-18 months.

lights.name: 信用利差(HY)
lights.note: 信用市场比股市先闻到危险；快速走阔=避险
lights.note_en: The credit market smells danger before equities do; a rapid widening means risk-off.
